title: Pull the platform concerns out of OrderApp

task.text: `OrderApp` authenticates, logs and counts requests as well as handling orders.
Move the cross-cutting concerns into a **sidecar** that wraps the app. `Pipeline.build(tokens, telemetry)` must keep answering, logging and counting exactly as now.

items: `OrderApp` keeps only the business logic: a no-argument constructor, no tokens, no `Telemetry`.
Add `Sidecar implements Handler` with constructor `Sidecar(Handler app, Set<String> tokens, Telemetry telemetry)`. It checks the `token` header, forwards to the app, then records the outcome.

checks.title: Bad or missing tokens are denied
Every request is logged, denials too
Sidecar works with an app it has never seen

hints.text: Which lines of `handle` are about orders, and which would be identical in any other service? The second group wants to live next to the app, not inside it.
`Sidecar` implements the same `Handler` interface as `OrderApp` and holds a `private final Handler app`. It does the token check and `telemetry.record`, and delegates in between.

lines: static Handler build(Set<String> tokens, Telemetry t) {
return new Sidecar(new OrderApp(), tokens, t);
